name: Engraved Leather Toiletry Bag
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from high-quality PU leather with a classic vintage look, this engraved leather toiletry bag offers durability, water resistance, and a smooth texture. 
  • The sturdy zipper design and reinforced handle provide reliable everyday use while maintaining a stylish appearance.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:

Designed with a spacious structure measuring approximately  9.85 in x 5.5 in x 5.5 in (24.89 cm x 13.97 cm x 13.97 cm), this toiletry bag provides ample storage space for toiletries, grooming essentials, cosmetics, shaving tools, and travel accessories while remaining compact and easy to carry.

 

Engraving Technology:
  • Customized with precision laser engraving technology, the design is permanently engraved onto the surface for a clean and elegant finish. 
  • The engraving creates a unique, personalized appearance that resists fading, peeling, or cracking over time.
  • The design can be engraved on either the top, the front of the bag, or both areas.

 

Functionality Use:
  • This versatile bag is ideal for organizing toiletries, shaving kits, cosmetics, skincare products, travel essentials, and small personal items. 
  • Featuring multiple compartments and secure zipper closures, it keeps your belongings neat and easily accessible for travel, business trips, gym visits, or everyday use.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

A practical and personalized gift choice for birthdays, Father's Day, anniversaries, Christmas, weddings, groomsmen gifts, travel lovers, or any special occasion. Its stylish design and custom engraving make it a thoughtful keepsake for family and friends.

 

Specification:
  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days average after payment and information updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
